description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Request a capability. Refusal is institutional. The result carries the primary actor block. capability is the name of the act, for example evidence.append (payload {content}), matter.read, or release:outside (consequential: it is refused unless the Human has granted it, and even then held for a Human decision). payload is a JSON object that belongs to that capability. atlas.list_capabilities shows which names you hold.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

capability.description: Name of the act, for example 'evidence.append' or 'release:outside'. atlas.list_capabilities shows what you hold and what you cannot do.

matter_id.description: Id of the matter you are admitted to (returned by atlas.bind_actor). Optional when you are bound to exactly one matter.

payload.description: Details of the requested act, as a JSON object. Describing an act does not authorize it.

name: atlas.request_capability
title: Request capability
